analysis.pricePatternEn: Higher Low, with the 5-day low of 94.98 above the 20-day low of 77.01
analysis.reason: RSI 58.4에서 67.6으로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. 5일 저가 94.98이 20일 저가 77.01보다 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성. MACD 히스토그램은 1.3211에서 1.2754로 소폭 악화되었으나, RSI 상승 추세와 가격의 Higher Low 패턴이 이를 상쇄.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 58.4 to 67.6, confirming an exit from oversold territory. The 5-day low of 94.98 is higher than the 20-day low of 77.01, forming a Higher Low pattern. Although the MACD histogram slightly worsened from 1.3211 to 1.2754, the RSI uptrend and the price's Higher Low pattern outweigh this.
